subject.title: refactor(agents): compress model prompts and tool instructions

question: May this PR intentionally change the values of deprecated GPT-5 prompt constants exported through the Plugin SDK?
rationale: Deprecation discourages new consumers but does not establish permission to change existing externally observable values, while the generated API baseline confirms a compatibility-visible difference.

options.title: Preserve Exported Values
options.body: Keep the existing SDK exports byte-stable and use separate compact constants for bundled runtime prompts.

options.title: Accept Value Change
options.body: Explicitly approve the deprecated export value changes with focused bundled-provider and external-consumer compatibility proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve Exported Values
recommendation.body: Keep the existing SDK exports byte-stable and use separate compact constants for bundled runtime prompts.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the current assignee and has the strongest merged-history connection to the central prompt and prompt-efficiency surfaces.
